aboutGame.title: What is SpellingRace?
paragraphs: SpellingRace is a free-to-play Roblox spelling game from Team Ry LLC, a verified developer account. A word appears on screen, you type it exactly, and the answer is scored on how fast and how clean it is — the game's own pitch is simple: the faster you answer, the more blocks you earn. Servers hold up to 12 players, and private servers are free.

There is no lore, no currency shop, and no code redemption menu — just words, a timer, and a scoreboard. Community tracker snapshots put SpellingRace at roughly 88.7 million visits with an 89.6% positive rating and a typical session of about nine minutes, which is why this wiki focuses on short, repeatable practice: word lists, typing drills, mode breakdowns, and the habits that decide a round in its first second.

modules.name: SpellingRace How to Play
modules.description: Learn the core SpellingRace loop — read the prompt, type the word, and submit before the timer runs out — with a beginner-friendly walkthrough of letters, speed, and scoring.

highlights.detail: Join a lobby of up to 12 players and wait for the countdown.
Read the whole word on screen before typing the first letter.
Type the answer exactly — one wrong letter stalls your run.
Submit as soon as the last letter lands; hesitation costs blocks.
Collect blocks based on how fast and how clean the answer was.
Re-queue and repeat the loop to build muscle memory.

highlights.label: Home Row
highlights.detail: Rest fingers on ASDF and JKL so your hands never leave the keys mid-word.

highlights.label: Chunking

highlights.label: Accuracy

highlights.label: Recovery

faq.title: SpellingRace FAQ
faq.description: Straight answers to the questions new players ask most about SpellingRace.

items.question: What is SpellingRace?
items.answer: SpellingRace is a free-to-play Roblox spelling game from Team Ry LLC. A word appears on screen, you type it as fast as you can, and each correct answer earns blocks. Servers hold up to 12 players, and private servers are free.

items.question: Does SpellingRace have codes?
items.answer: No. SpellingRace has no redeem-code system at all — there is no code box, no promo field, and no strings published by the developer. Rewards come from answering correctly and quickly, not from promo codes.

items.question: Is SpellingRace free to play?
items.answer: Yes. SpellingRace is free on Roblox, and Team Ry LLC also supports free private servers so you can practice with friends instead of strangers.

items.question: How do I earn more blocks in SpellingRace?
items.answer: Answer correctly and fast. Clean typing with no backspacing keeps your average reward per round high, and speed adds to the reward on top of the base payout for a correct spelling.

items.question: Which SpellingRace mode should a beginner start with?
items.answer: Start with Easy Mode to learn the round rhythm, then move up to Hard Mode once you can finish words without corrections.
